parameters.name: EncryptionKey
parameters.description: The ID of the custom key. You can call the [DescribeEncryptionKeyList](~~473860~~) operation to query the ID of the key.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-encryption-key --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --encryption-key ad463061-992d-4195-8a94-ed6300000000 --region cn-hangzhou
